answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement of 0.879 and sequence agreement of 0.422 fall inside the system-prompted ranges (0.861-0.908 and 0.31-0.48) and are below the fine-tuned ranges (0.900-0.938 and 0.47-0.64). TV of 0.130 and Token-DiFR gap of 0.455 also sit in the system-prompted ranges (0.108-0.144 and 0.28-0.52), while fine-tuned TV tops out at 0.099. KL of 0.490 is above every documented range, but it is the one measurement that points toward the largest-change category rather than away from it. Raw-score shift/TV of 4.2 is slightly above the system-prompted range (3.3-3.9) and inside the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8), so that value is ambiguous. Base and quantized are ruled out because the changes are too large. A strong fine-tune remains a possible alternative.
